def transform(grid):
    h = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==3 for v in row))
    w = next(j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j]==3 for i in range(len(grid))))
    out=[]
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        row=[]
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if grid[r][c]==3:
                row.append(3)
            else:
                d,e=abs(r-h),abs(c-w)
                yes = ((d%2==0 and (e<=d or e%2==0)) or (d%2==1 and e>d and e%2==0))
                row.append(4 if yes else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
# Demo 2 expected as compact row strings of digits

4040443440
4040403040
3333333333

4044443444
4000003000'''
exp2=[[int(x) for x in row] for row in exp2s.split()]
g2=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
for r in range(10): g2[r][6]=3
g2[4]=[3]*10

print('demo2 match',out2==exp2)
if out2!=exp2:
 for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(out2,exp2)):
